## TemplateEngine.\_processGAnswerNoteBlocks() method

Block: g-answer-note Extracts `<g-answer-note>` plain-text blocks from a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processGAnswerNoteBlocks(template: string): {
        [lang: string]: string;
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ \[lang: string\]: string; }

An object mapping language keys to their raw text content

## Remarks

Children form only; content is cleaned exactly like `<g-message>` and keyed by `lang` (`"default"` when absent; last block wins per lang). Raw content is preserved verbatim (including `{{var|filter}}` spans) for later compilation. The block is a validation marker for answers whose content comes from the caller (guest, web app), not the template. Plain-text rules are enforced by `validateBlockGAnswerNoteAttributes`<!-- -->, not here.

## Example


```typescript
const blocks = TemplateEngine._processGAnswerNoteBlocks(`<g-answer-note>Guest fallback {{kind}}</g-answer-note>`);
// Result: { default: 'Guest fallback {{kind}}' }
```
